role: Free functions for sharing the recap card: write a named PNG to tmp, find the topmost presenter, present a UIActivityViewController with an iPad popover anchor.
toplevel: Global free functions only; callers DashboardV2View+Chips.swift:391-392, RecoveryScoreDetailView+Panels.swift:378-379, PDFPreviewView.Coordinator.shareAction.

units.does: Creates tmp/RecapShare/ and writes the image PNG there as emuqu-<yyyy-MM-dd>-score-<score>.png (POSIX Gregorian date), returning that URL (presentShareSheet deletes it when the sheet closes); if pngData is nil, or the directory create or write throws (logged by attempt), returns the UIImage itself.
Finds the foreground-active UIWindowScene, takes the key window's root (or first window's), and walks presentedViewController while not being dismissed; returns nil when no active scene/root.

branches.cond: foreground-active UIWindowScene found and a root VC exists

branches.effect: use it; else ?? first window's root

branches.cond: presented VC exists and is not being dismissed
branches.effect: descend; else stop and return current

units.does: The item as a file URL when it is a URL directly inside recapShareDirectory (a recap PNG); nil otherwise (e.g. a PDF the preview still shows).
Returns a UIActivityViewController completion handler that deletes the given file (failure logged by attempt).

Creates a UIActivityViewController for one item; when the item is a recap PNG (recapShareFile) sets a completion that deletes it once the sheet closes (shared or cancelled); anchors its popover to the presenter's view centre (no arrow) when one exists (iPad), and presents it.
